messages.subject: RIL POPULATION - F5
parts:
hello

we have a RIL F5 population in plants and we want to map the markers to genetic distance and i have several questions
1.can we do it using the R/QTL package?
2.what is the command(how should i write the read.corss command?) that we should use in order to insert the data to R environment

thank you

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] RIL POPULATION - F5
parts:
You can, though R/qtl can't handle heterozygote genotypes in RIL.

You'd read the data something like:

mycross <- read.cross("csv", file="my file.csv", genotypes=c("AA", "BB"), crosstype="riself")

karl
